plugins.name: naqsha
plugins.description: Plan before code. You steer a researched plan and a designed interface on local pages; project files stay locked until you approve; then Claude builds it test-first and security-first, with reviews and cost tracking. Also audits existing codebases, teaches what was built, and makes demo videos of it.
